I couldn't do this research. My first attempt to fetch the commentary pages failed with a message saying I had no tool calls left, and a simple search attempt right after was blocked the same way. So I haven't read any of the sources.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Since I read nothing, I haven't written any verse notes. Notes written from memory would break those rules and couldn't be checked, so I left them out.

**What I had planned to read, so you or a later attempt can start here:**
- **Traditional verse-by-verse reading:** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-61/ and biblehub.com/commentaries/[gill | ellicott | pulpit]/psalms/61.htm. I'd also check preceptaustin.org and studylight.org for Psalm 61.
- **Protestant traditions:**
  - Baptist: Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* on spurgeon.org or ccel.org
  - Methodist: Wesley's Notes on wesley.nnu.edu
  - Reformed: Calvin's commentary on ccel.org
  - Lutheran and Pentecostal: lcms.org, 1517.org, ag.org
- **Modern scholarship:** the translator's notes at netbible.org/bible/Psalms+61, and bibleodyssey.org.
- **Catholic and Orthodox:** Augustine's exposition on newadvent.org. Catholic and Orthodox Bibles number this psalm 60, so it would be at newadvent.org/fathers/1801060.htm. I haven't checked that link.

If you ask again in a new message, my tools may be available again, and I'll do the research and write the notes in the format you asked for.
